And then these other things started about a year and seven months ago. Sometimes, I’ll just find myself staring blankly, my mind a complete void. I’ve noticed my language getting a bit... strange too. My thoughts will just turn into rhymes, it feels almost poetic sometimes, yet it makes no sense to anyone else. It's like 'the sun so bright, takes its flight, in the night…' You know? And I keep seeing flickers out of the corner of my eye – shadows, quick movements, but when I turn, there’s nothing there. It's unsettling.

But the most significant thing, and something I haven’t really told anyone, is this feeling that I'm… special. I have this profound sense that I possess a unique understanding, a secret power, almost as if I'm destined for something far greater than just being a professor. It's a conviction, a knowing, deep within me. Sometimes these thoughts are so powerful they make everything else seem trivial. This feeling, along with the seeing things, it’s been there, almost constantly, throughout this whole period of feeling down and sleeping too much."
